$comment: Skynet app registry. Data, not code — edit this to add or update apps. 'live' apps have a runnable adapter (location = module:Class). 'external' apps run on Joe's Mac/Cowork and Skynet coordinates them via shared memory + intents. 'planned' apps are not built yet.

apps.name: Health
apps.summary: Tracks Joe's health metrics (weight, sleep, workouts, BP, steps).

apps.name: Foreman
apps.summary: Job/field management — site photos, notes, and job tracking.

functions.name: note
functions.usage: skynet run foreman note text="framing done"

apps.name: Subtext
apps.summary: Automated iMessage follow-ups to subs and clients.

functions.name: followup
functions.usage: skynet run subtext followup to="Mike" msg="still need the quote"

apps.name: Selections App
apps.summary: Client finish/product selections for active jobs.

apps.name: Punch List App
apps.summary: End-of-job punch list items and sign-off.

apps.name: Brain Notes
apps.summary: Joe's Drive 'Brain' — passive memory (MASTER.md and sub-files).

functions.name: append
functions.usage: skynet run brain_notes append path=health/goals.md text="..."

functions.name: sync
functions.summary: Record a file inventory into memory
